explanation: Cutting breaks the apple's cells, letting an enzyme called polyphenol oxidase meet oxygen from the air. Together they convert compounds in the fruit into brown pigments called melanins.

options.text: Sugar in the apple caramelising in the air
An enzyme reacting with oxygen to build brown pigments
Dust from the air settling on the cut surface
The apple drying out and shrinking

prompt: A sliced apple left on a plate slowly turns brown. What causes the colour change?
